verdict.rationale: Jules lets a developer redirect in-progress work from the browser or API: they can review and approve plans, get notified when the task needs input, send messages to the agent, and give feedback so a stalled task continues. Finishing the work yourself only happens after the fact, through the generated diff or PR. There is no evidence of pulling a live session out of the cloud VM into a local editor or terminal, and one user reports there is no STOP button to interrupt a looping run. Missing for 10: handoff of an in-progress session into a local editor or terminal, a documented interrupt or stop control, and hands-on corroboration of mid-task redirection.
